detail.diff:
--- a/glm.toml
+++ b/glm.toml
@@ -0,0 +1,78 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+# GLM (Z.ai) backend-provider configuration — operator-owned.
+#
+# This file wires a coding agent to GLM as a MODEL BACKEND. Z.ai also ships a
+# first-party coding tool of its own, ZCode, which Z.ai's documentation calls
+# an "Agentic Development Environment"; this adapter does not configure
+# ZCode. An Anthropic-compatible or OpenAI-compatible coding agent is pointed
+# at GLM by setting the backend base URL and an auth token. This file records
+# both compatibility surfaces plus operator-configurable model-mapping
+# placeholders so any compatible agent can be wired to the GLM model family.
+# Replace every <...> placeholder; the auth token is a placeholder, never a
+# committed secret.
+#
+# This file is operator-owned. The GLM backend is not rule-bearing, so Apothem
+# projects NO shared-profile instruction content here (no rules, no opted-in
+# behaviors — a backend exposes none): the file carries only the backend
+# wiring below. Apothem writes this template only when the
+# file is absent; thereafter the file is yours: `apothem install` and
+# `apothem update` never overwrite it, and `apothem uninstall` removes it only
+# while it is still this unedited template.
+#
+# Vendor surface conventions are pinned at
+# src/apothem/harnesses/glm/STANDARD-CONVENTION-PIN.md (snapshotted against the
+# live Z.ai documentation).
+
+[provider]
+# Display label for the GLM model family. No specific model id is pinned here:
+# model ids are version-volatile, so the operator selects one from the current
+# Z.ai catalog at install time (see the [models] table below).
+name = "GLM (Z.ai)"
+family = "glm"
+docs = "https://docs.z.ai/"
+
+# Anthropic-compatible backend. Point an Anthropic-compatible coding agent at
+# GLM by exporting these environment variables before launching the agent.
+[backends.anthropic_compatible]
+base_url = "https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic"
+# Environment variables an operator sets so an Anthropic-compatible agent
+# routes to GLM instead of the default Anthropic endpoint. The three
+# ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL variables map the agent's opus / sonnet / haiku
+# model roles to GLM model ids, as documented at
+# https://docs.z.ai/devpack/tool/claude. Apothem pins no model id: fill each
+# <GLM_MODEL_ID> from the current Z.ai catalog.
+[backends.anthropic_compatible.env]
+ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL = "https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic"
+ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "<YOUR_ZAI_API_KEY>"
+API_TIMEOUT_MS = "<TIMEOUT_MS>"
+# TODO(clarify): Z.ai's own statements disagree on this role-to-model mapping,
+# so the three values stay placeholders and the operator chooses (statements
+# checked 2026-10-24; see STANDARD-CONVENTION-PIN.md):
+#   - The manual settings.json example at https://docs.z.ai/devpack/tool/claude
+#     maps opus and sonnet to glm-5.3[1m] and haiku to glm-5.3-flash[1m], and
+#     sets CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW to 1000000.
+#   - The same page's default mapping lists GLM-5.3-Flash for all three roles.
+#   - Z.ai's @z_ai/coding-helper 0.1.1 defaults to glm-5.3-flash, appends [1m]
+#     to all three roles, and writes a compaction window of 1048576.
+ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL = "<GLM_MODEL_ID>"
+ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL = "<GLM_MODEL_ID>"
+ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL = "<GLM_MODEL_ID>"
+
+# OpenAI-compatible backend. Point an OpenAI-compatible coding agent at GLM by
+# setting its base URL to this endpoint and supplying the API key.
+[backends.openai_compatible]
+base_url = "https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4"
+[backends.openai_compatible.env]
+OPENAI_BASE_URL = "https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4"
+OPENAI_API_KEY = "<YOUR_ZAI_API_KEY>"
+
+# Operator-configurable model-role placeholders for agents that take a model id
+# directly (for example an OpenAI-compatible agent). An Anthropic-compatible
+# agent reads the ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_*_MODEL variables above instead. Apothem pins
+# no model id (version-volatile); fill these from the current GLM catalog at
+# https://docs.z.ai/.
+[models]
+default = "<GLM_MODEL_ID>"
+fast = "<GLM_FAST_MODEL_ID>"
+reasoning = "<GLM_REASONING_MODEL_ID>"
